'''Unidentified Duroonian crawlers''' were spotted by [[Han Solo]] after nightfall on the planet [[Duroon]] during his adventures there in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]. They looked like bundles of straw, and slowly crawled through the fronds of [[fern-tree]]s.

*''[[Han Solo at Stars' End]]'' {{1st}}
